exact_frozen_rule.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if it Grand Theft Auto VI is officially released in the US by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source will be official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

question: GTA VI released by November 30?

facts: Rockstar’s Dec 5, 2023 official Trailer 1 page says Coming 2025 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Rockstar’s May 2, 2025 update moved its then-published schedule to May 26, 2026.
Rockstar’s Nov 6, 2025 update moved the announced date to Thursday, Nov 19, 2026.
source_facts.subject: schedule history

facts: Take-Two’s Aug 7, 2026 FY2027 Q1 release table lists GTA VI for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on Nov 19, 2026.
Rockstar’s Oct 15, 2026 Launch Trailer page is current promotional material, not an observed game release; the page/site states Coming Nov 19, 2026 and offers pre-order.
Current US PlayStation and Xbox product pages identify Nov 19, 2026 as release/availability date and present pre-order actions.
source_facts.subject: latest schedule evidence

facts: Rockstar Support last updated its platform/version FAQ Aug 18, 2026. It lists PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; digital Standard and Ultimate editions; physical Standard only.

The physical version contains a download code in the box and no disc. Support says retailer shipping/pickup is expected from Nov 12; the code supports preload. Digital preload begins at local midnight Nov 12.
Support’s code guidance assigns North America (US and Canada) as a PlayStation redemption region; Xbox codes are not region-locked.
Rockstar’s June 24 announcement says pre-orders begin June 25 at local midnight; current US stores display pre-order, not a completed release.
source_facts.subject: editions, platform, region and pre-release availability
